en: The postcard features three black-and-white photographs: one of a church square with a church tower (Kirchplatz), one of a village street with large trees and people gathered near a fence (Mittel-Ende), and one of a marketplace with trees lining the road and houses or shops on both sides (Marktplatz). The images are bordered by illustrations of flowers. The card has German text and appears to be from the early 20th century.
